page.overview:
Who is Ardent Quay's great-great-great-grandfather?

Ardent Quay's great-great-great-grandfather was a hyperspace prospector and astrogator who was renowned for founding one of the most legendary hyperspace routes in the galaxy. As a member of the Quay family, they were rumored to have a preternatural ability to intuitively navigate through hyperspace.
